measurement.scope: synchronous complete predict; both models resident; load and warmup excluded
measurement.system_power: macmon SMC PSTR estimate, including baseline machine power; not a calibrated external meter
measurement.integration: trapezoidal, monotonic receive timestamps; interpolated interval boundaries
measurement.idle_subtraction: mean of preceding and following settled idle; negative values retained
measurement.counter_caveat: CPU energy reports zero on this OS; do not sum component counters or call them complete chip power
measurement.ratio_identity: speed * average power reduction = energy per decision improvement (do not multiply speed again)
